description: Transform 3 showcase screens (AI Review, New Content, Rule Impact Sandbox) into premium visual experiences using new motion components. These are the highest-priority, most-visible screens that demonstrate the platform's capabilities.
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-001 findings to understand available motion components

AI Review (src/v2/components/views/creator/AIReviewView.tsx): Add sequential reveal to Review Crew with delay={index*0.1}, wrap scanning overlay on poster preview when scanning=true using ScanningEffect, wrap PosterCanvas with ImageHoverEffect for zoom, wrap findings in AnimatedCard with stagger, use AnimatedBadge for verified/rejected citations, add PulseDot next to score during processing

New Content (src/v2/components/views/creator/NewContentView.tsx): Replace drag-drop div with UploadAnimation component passing isDragging state, show ProcessingSpinner briefly on file select then fade in preview with AnimatedCard, wrap form sections in Reveal for scroll entrance, replace brand check badge with AnimatedBadge, show ProcessingSpinner during check, animate checkmark with SuccessCheck on completion, use AnimatedCounter for findings count, add checkmark draw animation to checklist items, slide in 'Ready to submit' banner from bottom when all checked, wrap guideline cards in HoverLiftCard with interactive prop

Rule Impact Sandbox (src/v2/components/views/manager/RuleImpactSandboxView.tsx): Wrap rule input panel in HoverLiftCard elevation='high', add glow shadow during edit, replace simulate button with AnimatedButton variant='primary', show ProcessingSpinner with 'Simulating...' text during processing, use LayoutTransition for before/after split view, wrap metric cards in AnimatedCard with stagger, use RingProgress with glow for impact score, use NumberTicker for affected submissions count, add Sparkline draw animation to compliance trend, wrap activation modal in AnimatedModal with warning tone glow
Test each screen after modification: npm run dev, navigate to screen, verify animations play smoothly, verify all API data still loads, test interactions (buttons, hover, etc.)
Ensure no console errors or warnings
Preserve all existing API calls, data fetching logic, and authentication checks
acceptance_criteria: AI Review screen: Review Crew cards animate in sequence, scanning overlay appears when running review, poster zooms on hover, findings stagger in, badges animate, compliance score displays correctly

New Content screen: Drag-drop zone glows and scales on drag, file upload shows spinner then preview, form sections reveal on scroll, brand check animates with spinner and result badge, checklist checkmarks animate, ready banner slides in, guideline cards lift on hover

Rule Impact Sandbox screen: Input panel has elevated card style, simulate button has micro-interactions, results show with stagger, before/after views transition smoothly, metrics animate, activation modal has warning glow
All existing functionality works (API calls, form submissions, navigation)
verification: Run 'npm run typecheck' to confirm no TypeScript errors
Navigate to /creator/ai-review, click 'Run semantic review', observe agent animations and scanning effect, hover poster to see zoom, scroll findings to see stagger

Navigate to /creator/new-content, drag file over drop zone to see glow and scale, select file to see upload animation, scroll form to see reveals, click 'Run brand check' to see processing and result animation, check all checklist items to see ready banner
Navigate to /manager/sandbox, edit a rule to see focus glow, click 'Simulate' to see processing, view results to see stagger and animations, click 'Activate' to see modal
Turn on 'prefers-reduced-motion' in OS settings, reload pages, verify animations are skipped and final states display immediately
Check browser console for errors (should be none)
Expected: All 3 screens feel premium, polished, and highly interactive while preserving all functionality
findings: AIReviewView already satisfied its FEAT-002 scope from a prior run (ScanningEffect around PosterCanvas while scanning, ImageHoverEffect zoom, Stagger/StaggerItem on all three finding lists, AnimatedBadge for verified/rejected citations and violation counts, PulseDot beside the score during a run, EmptyState for the no-submission case). I verified it against the spec and left it unchanged rather than rewriting working code. NewContentView: drop zone now uses UploadAnimation (scale 1.02 + shadow-glow-brand while dragging, icon lifts -3px, label switches to 'Drop to attach'); preview is wrapped in AnimatedCard and shows ProcessingSpinner until the media actually fires onLoad/onLoadedData (real load state, not a fake timer) then fades in; the four form sections are wrapped in ScrollReveal with staggered delays 0/0.05/0.1/0.15; the brand-check badge is now AnimatedBadge (sage solid on pass, amber solid with AnimatedCounter for the finding count, brand soft for 'Not run'); the running state uses ProcessingSpinner; result panels fade+lift in on arrival and SuccessCheck keeps its draw animation; checklist checkmarks pop with a scale/rotate spring and the box pulses; the 'Ready to submit' banner slides up from y:14; guideline rows use HoverLiftCard with 0.05s stagger. RuleImpactSandboxView: run panel is a HoverLiftCard elevation='high' that gains a forest-green ring/glow via inline boxShadow while a proposed change is typed (inline style because motion's whileHover animates boxShadow and would otherwise clobber a utility class); simulate button is AnimatedButton with ProcessingSpinner + 'Simulating…'; the four Metric cards are AnimatedCards with 0.06s stagger and the 'Need attention' metric uses NumberTicker; RingProgress got a tone-matched glow (danger/amber/sage by attentionPct); status badge is AnimatedBadge mapped Activated=sage solid, Failed=danger soft, else brand; before/after panels slide in from -14px/+14px with the arrow scaling in between; activation modal warning block carries an amber glow and its busy state uses ProcessingSpinner. TWO DELIBERATE DEVIATIONS: (1) 'Sparkline draw animation to compliance trend' was NOT implemented — this view has no compliance-trend time series; the only chart is BarSeries over this run's own totals, so adding a sparkline would have required inventing data, which the project forbids. BarSeries already animates on mount. (2) LayoutTransition is applied to the results column (mode='list', preserving the vertical stack) rather than to the before/after comparison, because LayoutTransition's grid mode forces 1/2/3 equal columns and would destroy the 1fr-auto-1fr comparison layout; the before/after pair got directional motion reveals instead. Verified: npm run typecheck exits 0 with zero errors, npx vite build exits 0.
